items.why_en: Adds new Advanced Distributions modes to the Cloner for precise placement and animation of clones along edges, polygon outlines, or UV-mapped surfaces, without complex rigging.

items.name: Tripo AI
items.why: 升級的 3D 分割工具，沿更智能的結構邊界分割模型，提高綁骨工作流程的效率和資產品質。
items.why_en: Upgraded 3D segmentation tool segments models along smarter structural boundaries, improving efficiency and asset quality in rigging workflows.

items.name: Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 + Power Automate + Azure AI Services (強化連接器)

items.why_en: Enhanced enterprise automation by deeply integrating Copilot with custom workflows and Azure AI models for more complex business processes.

items.name: ComfyUI + Stability AI Video Model + ElevenLabs (多模態生成工作流)

items.why_en: Seamless integration of Stability AI's latest video model with ElevenLabs audio via new ComfyUI nodes, boosting multimodal creation efficiency.

items.why_en: GitHub Copilot Enterprise launched new features allowing deep integration with Azure DevOps pipelines and custom LLMs via Azure OpenAI Service, optimizing enterprise code generation.
